hooks.name: Related tests and typecheck on save
hooks.description: When a TypeScript file under src/ or scripts/ is saved, run the Vitest files related to it and tsc --noEmit. Shell command only, no agent prompt.

action.command: sh -c 'node .kiro/hooks/bin/related-tests.mjs; s=$?; node scripts/log_hook.ts "Related tests and typecheck on save" "exit $s"; exit $s'
